description: This file defines the StatelessWorkerPlacement class, which implements a placement strategy for stateless worker grains in Orleans. It manages properties such as maximum local instances and whether idle workers are proactively removed.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerPlacement
classes.description: A placement strategy for managing stateless worker grains, allowing multiple instances on any host with configurable maximum instances and idle worker removal behavior.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the placement strategy with current property values.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the placement strategy based on grain properties, setting MaxLocal and RemoveIdleWorkers accordingly.

methods.name: PopulateGrainProperties
methods.description: Populates grain properties with current configuration values for MaxLocal and RemoveIdleWorkers.
